verdict.rationale: Fellow's own pages say it records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Users can record with a visible bot or bot-free from the desktop, and can choose when to record, pause, or resume, with org-wide recording policies on top. The evidence is all vendor marketing rather than in-depth docs or hands-on testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of capture reliability, and detailed docs on per-meeting auto-record and auto-join configuration.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles with enterprise-grade security and human-level accuracy.

Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Users choose when to record, pause, or resume capture when part of a conversation needs to stay off the record.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
